svg.aria-label: The basement with the D&D studio by the office: studio, office, bins by the utilities, the finished room as the play room, the lane
svg.text: the furnace is through this wall,
which is why the bins are here
a gate at the door; the closet takes toys
or a guest room as it stands, bed and all
damp band at the slab: check
two low windows on the far wall, about
front, the street side · 1 square = 1 foot · "about" marks a spot taped later
